How payment timing works

Covers October 2026 · Calculated schedule as of October 16, 2026; the date refreshes in your browser.

VA pays after the benefit month. If the scheduled date falls on a weekend or federal holiday, payment moves to the preceding business day. Bank availability may vary.

More benefits. More support.

Explore 9 programs for payments, health care, housing, and education.

Showing 9 benefits to explore

Monthly compensation

Special Monthly Compensation

For Veterans with certain severe service-connected disabilities or a qualifying need for daily personal help.

What it offers

May provide a higher compensation rate for specific needs. Not included in this calculator.

Explore SMC ↗
Compensation at the 100% rate

Individual Unemployability

For Veterans whose service-connected disabilities prevent substantially gainful employment and who meet VA requirements.

What it offers

May pay at the 100% rate even with a lower rating. It replaces the payment rate; it is not a second disability check.

Check IU eligibility ↗
Separate monthly benefit

Social Security Disability (SSDI)

For people who meet Social Security’s work-history and disability requirements.

What it offers

You may receive SSDI and VA disability compensation together. A VA rating alone does not establish SSDI eligibility.

Read the SSA guide ↗
Travel reimbursement

Health care travel pay

For eligible Veterans traveling to approved health care appointments; additional travel eligibility rules apply.

What it offers

May reimburse mileage and qualifying travel expenses. Some expenses need advance approval.

Check travel pay ↗
Annual allowance

Clothing allowance

For qualifying damage to clothing from a device or prescribed skin medicine used for a service-connected disability.

What it offers

An annual payment to help replace affected clothing. Check the current requirements and application process.

Review clothing allowance ↗
Housing grant

Adapted housing grants

For Veterans with certain qualifying service-connected disabilities who need an accessible home.

What it offers

May help buy, build, or adapt a home. Grant type and permitted uses depend on your circumstances.

Explore housing grants ↗
Health care services

VA health care

For Veterans who meet service and discharge requirements; other enrollment rules and exceptions may apply.

What it offers

Access medical care, prescriptions, and related services. Costs depend on your eligibility and priority group.

Check health care eligibility ↗
Education support

GI Bill benefits

For eligible Veterans pursuing approved education or training. Your service and program determine eligibility.

What it offers

May help with tuition, books, and housing. What is paid—and to whom—depends on the program and enrollment.

Explore education benefits ↗
Income-based monthly pension

Veterans Pension

For qualifying wartime Veterans who meet age or disability requirements and income and net-worth limits.

What it offers

An alternative to VA disability compensation, not an extra payment on top of it. The two cannot be received at the same time.

Review pension eligibility ↗

A starting point, not an eligibility decision. Each program has its own rules; benefits are not automatically added to your calculated payment. VA pension and disability compensation cannot be paid at the same time. Understand the difference ↗

A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Less guesswork.
More clarity.

Does a COLA increase change my disability rating?+

No. COLA adjusts the payment amount. It does not change your combined disability rating.

When would the new annual rates start?+

VA explains that annual COLAs take effect December 1 and appear in the payment around New Year. If that rule applies for 2027, the expected first payment at the new rate is December 31, 2026, covering December 2026. This date is calculated, not a confirmed individual deposit date.

Why might my actual deposit be different?+

Your award can include special compensation, offsets, withholding, or other adjustments. Banks may also make funds available at different times. Confirm the amount in your VA award letter and payment history.

How are these estimates calculated?+

We look up your household’s regular compensation using VA’s 2026 table. For 2027, we multiply that monthly total by 1.036 and round to cents. Annual increase means the rounded monthly difference multiplied by 12. This is an estimate until official 2027 amounts are verified.
